result.summary: zig build and zig build migrate both exit 0; benchmark env clean. test-integration-iss503 (test_iss503_rls_removal.zig) passes 4/4 in isolation, correcting BACKEND-DEV's step-03e attribution: TC-ISS503-04 uses normal TestHarness/pool CRUD, not raw-SQL re-execution (that pattern applies to TC-ISS503-01/02/03). However, TC-DB-01-01/TC-DB-01-02 (db_integration_test.zig) -- the definitive original GitHub #357 acceptance bar -- FAIL reproducibly in two independently isolated `zig build test-integration` runs. Root cause identified via schema_migrations timestamp forensics: GBL-084/102/103 do NOT re-execute via the gated Migrations.run() path in either run (applied_at timestamps unchanged), ruling out GBL-103's own guard re-firing. The actual mechanism: tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig's TC-ISS503-02/03 independently re-execute GBL-084_rls_removal.sql's raw, UNSCOPED guard clause (no tenant_type/slug filter -- migrations/GBL-084_rls_removal.sql:32-34, unchanged) via conn.simpleQuery(), bypassing GBL-103's narrower re-execution-gate scoping entirely. zig build test-integration runs ~24 binaries as concurrent build-graph dependencies against one shared bpm_test DB by default, so this binary's concurrent execution alongside db_integration_test.zig's binary reproduces the original #357 symptom via a path this rework's 3 files (GBL-103, lint T060, iss107 TC-107-04 cleanup) do not and cannot touch. This is a real, pre-existing, reproducible gap, not introduced by this rework. Full suite: 553/666 passed, 103 failed, 10 skipped -- within the established 60-107 baseline range, no new failures attributable to this rework's changes. Also independently confirmed (per src/design/iss0100-rework1-guard-slug-scoping.md §4) that test-integration-env is mislabeled -- it compiles the full suite, not a scoped ENV-01..05 subset.
